description: Where a range's knobs sit on the window's slot boundaries (0..n, days ascending): start where its first day begins, end where its last one ends. A knob before the window is -1 and after it n + 1, unless there's no history that way (canPanEarlier, canPanLater), where it sits on the edge.

cases.name: a one-day selection's knobs are a slot apart
no history on either side: the knobs sit on the edges
a range wholly before the window
a range wholly after the window
